sentences.text: Christopher Ryan Hardwick -LRB- born November 23 , 1971 -RRB- is an American stand-up comedian , voice actor , television host , writer , producer , podcaster , and musician .	television	television

He is the chief executive officer of Nerdist Industries , the digital division of Legendary Entertainment .	chief executive officer	chief executive officer	Nerdist Industries	Nerdist Industries	Legendary Entertainment	Legendary Entertainment
